M23 — 2026-10-12
`claude setup-token` makes a 1-year OAuth token with scope user:inference only; POST /v1/code/sessions/<id>/archive answers it HTTP 401 (drive-lanes, 2026-10-12), so it cannot archive cloud sessions. Only the CLI's full login token can, and reading that from the keychain is refused to an agent as credential exploration. Running setup-token from an agent: a Python pty (pty.fork) works; macOS script(1) does not take piped input.
